subject: Dedicated capacity pricing: token econ, throughput targets & GPU preference
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stanton <alex.stanton@helixbank.com>, Sara Khan <sara.khan@helixbank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + pricing questions (dedicated lanes)

Alex / Sara — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and two asks so we can put a tailored Dedicated proposal together: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Target workload: mix of chat & extraction calls; average prompt+response ~ 1.2k tokens, peak bursts up to ~5k tokens/session.
- Target steady-state throughput: ~120 concurrent requests, ~8M tokens/day baseline, 12–15M tokens/day peak.
- Required latency SLO: p95 generation <= 450ms for 2k token responses.
- Security: SOC2 + VPC peering required; will pull evidence in procurement stage.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm budget range for a reserved capacity commit (monthly or annual) and target unit price you’re aiming for ($/1M tokens)? We need a target to model GPU mix.
2) Any internal preference or constraint on GPU type (A100 vs H100) or vendor (NVIDIA A100/H100, on dedicated clusters) — this affects per-token cost and throughput profiles.

Next steps I propose: I’ll send two pricing scenarios (conservative A100 mix + performance H100 mix) with expected $/1M tokens and throughput per reserved lane, plus a short MAP document and benchmark CSV. Camila will follow with procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: HelixBank_MAP_v1.docx (MAP), throughput_benchmarks_A100_vs_H100.csv (lab results)

From: Alex Stanton <alex.stanton@helixbank.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@helixbank.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixbank.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + pricing questions (dedicated lanes)

Thanks Rishi — solid recap. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Budget: rough internal target is $4k–$9k / $1M tokens depending on latency and availability SLAs. We are aiming lower if the dedicated lane guarantees p95 <500ms at 2k tokens.
2) GPU preference: our infra team would prefer H100 if price delta is within ~30% of A100 — we care about tail latency for live customer-facing agents. If H100 gives a clear p95 improvement for our mix, we’re open.
3) Volume confirmation: baseline 8M/day; we can commit to a 6–9 month pilot with 12M/day headroom if pricing looks good.

Action for you: send the two scenario pricing and the rough commit path so I can present to finance and infra.

—Alex
Alex Stanton
Head of AI Platforms
HelixBank

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stanton <alex.stanton@helixbank.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing scenarios + throughput notes (A100 vs H100)

Alex — attached are the two scenarios we discussed. High-level notes below (attachments: HelixBank_Redwood_Quote_v2.pdf, throughput_benchmarks_A100_vs_H100.csv):

Scenario A — Cost-conscious (A100-heavy):
- Assumes blended A100 lanes with some GPU sharing.
- Modeled unit price: $3,900 / $1M tokens (baseline econ with batching & prefix caching).
- Expected steady throughput per reserved lane: ~2.1M tokens/day; p95 ~520ms at 2k tokens (depends on batching config).

Scenario B — Performance (H100-preferred):
- Assumes H100-optimized lanes, reserved KV cache, tighter allocation.
- Modeled unit price: $5,100 / $1M tokens (higher infra cost, lower per-token latency).
- Expected steady throughput per lane: ~3.4M tokens/day; p95 ~330–420ms at 2k tokens.

Commit paths we recommend:
- Pilot (6 months): reserve 2 H100 lanes (allows headroom to hit 10–12M tokens/day with autoscale burst) + option to convert lanes to long-term annual commitment after month 4.
- Mid commit (annual): reserve 4 blended lanes (mix A100/H100) with throughput guarantees and monthly token true-up.

Notes on assumptions: token accounting uses post-processed generation tokens (prompt + response). Benchmarks attached include 1–5k token profiles and tail latency percentiles.

Next steps: Camila — can you prepare a short procurement checklist & a draft timeline (DocuSign path) that we can send to Alex’s procurement team? Alex — if this looks directionally right, indicate which scenario you prefer and we’ll move to a draft PO + DocuSign.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HelixBank_Redwood_Quote_v2.pdf, throughput_benchmarks_A100_vs_H100.csv

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stanton <alex.stanton@helixbank.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixbank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Procurement checklist & proposed timeline (HelixBank pilot)

Alex / Procurement — looping in a short checklist to speed review. We can tailor any step based on your procurement cadence.

Procurement checklist (recommended minimal path):
- Draft PO (Redwood will prepare based on selected scenario).
- SOC2 + pen test summary (we will attach evidence).
- Data processing agreement + standard T&Cs redlines (we accept most enterprise redlines; please flag any must-haves).
- VPC peering details and IP allowlist for pilot.
- Invoice cadence: monthly for pilot; net-30 default.

Proposed timeline (fast path):
- Day 0–3: Alex confirms scenario and signs LOI (email ok).
- Day 3–10: Redwood sends draft PO + DocuSign; procurement reviews SOC2/KYC docs.
- Day 10–20: Pilot provisioning (VPC peering + provisioning reserved lanes).
- Day 21+: Pilot live; weekly sync to check KPIs.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HelixBank_MAP_v1.docx

From: Alex Stanton <alex.stanton@helixbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@helixbank.com>, Sara Khan <sara.khan@helixbank.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checklist & proposed timeline (HelixBank pilot)

Thanks Camila — that timeline works. We’re inclined to go with Scenario B (H100-preferred) given tail-latency sensitivity.

Commit: we can do a 6-month pilot with the option to expand to annual after month 4. Target baseline commit: 10M tokens/day. Budget target: aiming for ~$5k / $1M tokens (within your Scenario B range).

Please send a draft PO and DocuSign link and I’ll route to procurement this afternoon. Also include the SOC2 packet and the benchmark CSV for our infra team.

—Alex
Head of AI Platforms, HelixBank
Attachments requested: HelixBank_Redwood_Quote_v2.pdf, throughput_benchmarks_A100_vs_H100.csv
